mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1, indicating strengthening economic demand, boosts consumer and business confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 50% of quarters with positive GDPC1 growth.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 1.5%, signaling a tightening monetary cycle, investors anticipate reduced borrowing capacity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 1.5-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between rising PAYEMS (indicating a strong labor market) and low UNRATE (below 6%) creates a 'goldilocks' zone, where the economy is neither too hot nor too cold, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 40% of 'goldilocks' zone instances.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in INDPRO, signaling improved industrial production, enhances economic efficiency, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, but only during non-recessionary periods.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC falls below 0.01 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in non-recessionary growth periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When HOUST exceeds its 6-month moving average, indicating a surge in housing market activity, it foreshadows broader economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 45% of instances where HOUST surpasses its 6-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: The combination of low FEDFUNDS (below 0.5%) and rising CPIAUCSL (above 2% YoY) indicates a potential inflation overshoot, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.025 over any 1.5-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in high inflation periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.15).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decrease in UNRATE, indicating a tightening labor market, boosts wage growth expectations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, but only when RSAFS is above its 3-month average.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 35% of instances where UNRATE decreases and RSAFS is above its 3-month average.

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: GDPC1's year-over-year growth rate provides a persistent, albeit noisy, signal for the overall health of the economy, with higher growth rates corresponding to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC falls below 0.005 over any 3-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns do not correlate significantly with GDPC1 YoY growth (p > 0.2).
